# Tidewater Kayak Hire -- booking site (draft, spring)

## First version
- Customers book a kayak for a time slot (1, 2 or 4 hours) on a chosen day.
- Customers pay the full hire price online when booking.
- Staff see the day's bookings and mark kayaks as out and returned.

## Cancellation rule
A customer may cancel free of charge up to 24 hours before the slot.

## Later
- Guided tours.
